solution_steps: Flip summon Granadora to gain 1000 LP.
Use Back to Square One to return Granadora to the top of your deck. Discard Monster Reincarnation as a cost.
Use Premature Burial to return Sacred Crane to the field and draw Granadora again.
Now flip Cyber-Stein and activate his effect to get Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon.
Attack Des Lacooda with Cyber-Stein, then have your monsters attack directly.
